paragraphs: Rents in Ireland are still going up, but more slowly. A new report from the property website Daft shows this.
Between June and September, rents went up by 0.9%. This is the smallest rise for these months since 2020. Over one year, rents went up by 7.3%.
The average rent is now €2,239 a month. That is much higher than before 2020. Rents went up most in Cork city and Galway city.
There are more homes to rent now. On 1 November, almost 2,800 homes were available to rent. This is more than last year. But it is still much less than before Covid.
Ronan Lyons is a professor at Trinity College Dublin. He wrote the report. He says Ireland still needs to build many more homes.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭的租金仍在上漲，但速度變慢了。
房地產網站Daft的一份新報告顯示了這一點。
從六月到九月，租金上漲了0.9%。
這是自2020年以來這幾個月最小的漲幅。
一年下來，租金上漲了7.3%。
現在平均租金是每月2,239歐元。
這比2020年以前高出許多。
科克市和高威市的租金漲得最多。
現在可出租的房子變多了。
11月1日，有將近2,800間房子可以出租。
這比去年多。
但仍然比新冠疫情前少很多。
羅南·萊昂斯是都柏林聖三一學院的教授。
這份報告是他寫的。
他說愛爾蘭仍需要蓋更多的房子。

paragraphs: Rents in Ireland are rising more slowly, according to a new report from the property website Daft. Between June and September, rents went up by 0.9%. This was the smallest increase for that time of year since 2020.

Rents are still 7.3% higher than a year ago. The average monthly rent across the country is now €2,239, which is 43% more than before 2020. In Dublin, rents rose by 6.3% in a year. In Cork city they rose by 11.3%, and in Galway city by 10.3%.

More homes are now available to rent. On 1 November, there were almost 2,800 homes on the market. This was the highest number for November since 2021. However, it is still far below the normal level of about 4,400 before the pandemic.

Ronan Lyons, an economics professor at Trinity College Dublin, wrote the report. New rules since March let landlords move rents up to market level between tenants. He said homes listed after March were about 3% more expensive than similar homes listed before.
Lyons said there are still not enough homes. He blamed high building costs and uncertainty about planning.
sentZh: 根據房地產網站Daft的新報告，愛爾蘭租金上漲的速度變慢了。
從六月到九月，租金上漲了0.9%。
這是自2020年以來每年同一時期最小的漲幅。
租金仍比一年前高7.3%。
全國平均月租現在是2,239歐元，比2020年以前高43%。
都柏林的租金一年內上漲了6.3%。
科克市上漲了11.3%，高威市上漲了10.3%。
現在可出租的房屋變多了。
11月1日，市場上有將近2,800間房屋。
這是自2021年以來十一月份的最高數字。
